author: Warrens269
quote: What a way too ruin a franchise, I have been playing gta for over half my life. This game is horrific and I’m left wondering how we got here, one mission is actually moving a sofa around the house?? Then it’s a half hour long mission driving to the shop for Lucia too get her flowers, snacks and jewellery? After that long winded pointless mission it’s onto the next one.. painting the walls and fixing the roof???? It’s like a terrible sims simulator, I waited so long for this game and grew up playing gta but this is me out, what a waste of money!!!
